music.title: 31st Street Blues
music.composer: not credited on the file page (arranged and directed by Fletcher Henderson)
music.performer: Fletcher Henderson's Club Alabam' Orchestra (Fletcher Henderson, piano/director; Coleman Hawkins, tenor sax; Don Redman, alto sax/clarinet; Elmer Chambers, cornet)
music.file: File:31st Street Blues - Henderson's Club Alabam' Orchestra (1923).mp3
music.license_quote: Under the Classics Protection and Access Act ( 17 U.S.C. § 1401 ), this sound recording is in the public domain in the United States because it was published before January 1, 1926.
music.human_check: the page gives the full session story: recorded in New York City on November 26, 1923, released as Perfect 14223 in March 1924, the first record credited to Henderson's Club Alabam' Orchestra, named after the basement club/speakeasy the band had just taken residence in
music.why: a real 1923 speakeasy basement-club band recording - the smoky jazz cellar is literally where this record was born

not_found.searched: Commons audio search 'match struck sound', 'striking match', 'match', 'matchstick lighting fire' - only spoken-word and pronunciation files
Commons audio search 'ice glass clink sound', 'ice cubes glass', 'ice cubes' - no ice dropped in a glass; a pouring-iced-tea file exists but is pouring, not ice in glass
Commons audio search 'crowd murmur bar ambience' - no qualifying club crowd recording without music
Commons audio search 'crowd murmur bar ambience', 'glass clink' - no bar ambience recording (glasses/bottles/low talk) found
Commons audio search 'rain city street night sound', 'rain' - rain recordings found are residential/exterior (e.g. a house in Glenshaw PA), none a city street at night
Commons audio search 'arcade ambience crowd' - no on-site arcade recording
Commons audio search 'pinball machine' - pronunciation files only
Commons audio search 'coin spinning table' - no coin-spinning recording
Commons audio search 'pouring coins' - no poured-coins recording (a bag-of-coins jingle exists but is coins handled in a cloth bag, not poured out)
Commons audio search 'music box' - music boxes playing melodies only; no winding-without-melody recording
Commons audio search 'aquarium bubbling', 'bubbling water' - no aquarium/tank bubbling recording
Commons audio search 'fountain water plaza' - a town-square fountain (PD, 85 s) exists but the slot asks for a mall fountain
Commons audio search 'motorcycle passing by' - only a market soundscape with followable speech and mixed traffic
Commons audio search 'seagulls cries', 'seagulls morning' - no gull recording
Commons audio search 'crickets night' - night choruses found are frog-led with rain; no crickets-dominant recording
Commons audio search 'typewriter typing' - the only typewriter file is a lone end-of-line ding whose source is a Freesound upload; the hunt excludes Freesound, so it was not filed
Commons audio search 'dial-up modem' - results are data files encoded as audio and a bare 2100 Hz answer tone, not a recording of a real modem connecting
